steps.title: Configure pipette and parameters
steps.instruction: Load the P300 multichannel GEN2 pipette on the specified mount (left or right). Set the reservoir type for slot 1. Set the blowout height from the well bottom (e.g., ~5.4 mm for a 200 µL volume). Set the mix aspiration and dispensing flow rates as required.

steps.title: Load reagents
steps.instruction: Place PBS buffer in row 1 of a 12‑row trough. Load 200 µL of chemical mix into column 1 and column 7 of a 96‑well Costar microplate. Ensure both labwares are Opentrons‑verified.

steps.title: Add PBS to columns
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, dispense 180 µL of PBS from the trough into each of columns 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12. Change tips after dispensing.

steps.title: Mix column 1 and transfer to 2
steps.instruction: Mix column 1 with the P300‑8‑channel pipette 6 times using 200 µL volume. Aspirate 20 µL of chemical mix from column 1 and dispense into column 2. Mix column 2 10 times with 20 µL. Perform a blowout in column 2. Change tips.

steps.title: Mix column 7 and transfer to 8
steps.instruction: Mix column 7 with the P300‑8‑channel pipette 6 times using 200 µL volume. Aspirate 20 µL of chemical mix from column 7 and dispense into column 8. Mix column 8 10 times with 20 µL. Perform a blowout in column 8. Change tips.
